cases.assertion: production SecretStore reads and issues require tenant and purpose binding
errors events traces workflow payloads and API responses never contain the secret value
sensitive tool fields are redacted before event trace or ObjectStore write while safe output remains
an unclassified sensitive value blocks persistence with a finite error code
repeating a tenant-scoped revoke produces one effective transition
new calls cannot obtain a revoked credential reference after rotation
each settled model call records profile and price version with token and cache usage
missing or stale pricing returns a classified result and never silently charges zero
a provider failure distinguishes no usage from usage pending and does not auto-retry billing
concurrent reservations and settlements cannot cross tenant boundaries or double count
publishing a changed payload creates a new version and cannot mutate a released version
a running task resolves behavior from its pinned registry revision
canary promotion and rollback move a default pointer without overwriting released content
missing or below-threshold evaluation evidence prevents Registry write and default changes
a failed Promote leaves the previous default version selected
older clients can ignore new price secret and release metadata without seeing secret values
Task State and background scans do not become a second authoritative cost lifecycle
